column1: # MIRROR - NOT CANONICAL as of 2026-09-08.
# Canonical: ZAOOS research/identity/claims/retracted.tsv (see its README for why).
# This copy is the last-resort fallback for checkouts without ZAOOS. Delete it
# once bettercallzaal/ZAOOS#3460 merges. zao-claims-check warns loudly if the two
# have drifted, because two AI-readable surfaces disagreeing is the worst
# possible outcome. [re-check: 2026-09-15]
# zao retracted-claims ledger. One claim per line, TAB-separated, 6 fields.
# id
# Read by `zao-claims-check`. A pattern here must not appear unless the LINE also
# matches that row's `allow`, or carries a global exemption (struck, RETRACTED,
# negated phrasing, or [CLAIM-OK: <id> <why>]).
# scope:
#   all  - the claim is FALSE and must not survive anywhere. Enforced on every
#          scanned file. Use when the thing did not happen or the number is wrong.
#   public - the claim is TRUE but must not appear in PUBLIC COPY. Enforced only
#            on paths the repo names in .claims-public (one glob per line). A
#            repo declaring none is reported as unchecked, never passed quietly.
#            From Zaal 2026-09-08: "$5K PUBLIC, $25K INTERNAL ONLY" - a number
#            can be correct and still be barred from a page.
#   new  - the claim is TRUE HISTORY but must not be written FRESH. Enforced only
#          on staged/changed files (--staged). Use for retired partners: the
#          instruction is "do not reference it again", not "scrub the archive",
#          and the glossary keeps their spellings "so old docs can be read, not
#          written". A whole-tree ban here produced 2146 hits across the research
#          library on 2026-09-08 and would have made the check unusable.
takeover-2025
column6: Never happened - the proposal did not pass (Zaal direct). Entered as a HackMD PLAN, was recorded in doc 742 as "Shipped", and reached a published card. The COC Concertz #7 "WaveWarZ Takeover" of 2026-07-18 is a DIFFERENT and REAL event - that is what the allow column protects.

column1: third-consecutive-irl
column6: A count resting entirely on takeover-2025. ZAO-PALOOZA 2024 is the one NYC IRL proof point, not the first of three.

column1: third-year-conference
column6: False for the same reason. NFT NYC 2025 ran 23-27 June; Zaal was in New York in May, for FarCon. 2026 is the SECOND time at this conference, after 2024, and not consecutive.

column1: jango-alumni
column6: Zaal direct: JANGO UU is INACTIVE in ZAO work, actively making music, busy with life. He is the ORIGIN figure, not an alumnus. Supersedes doc 722f.

column1: candy-impact3
column6: Candy no longer works at Impact3, so she is not a current sponsorship route into it. NARROWED 2026-09-08: the first version of this pattern matched ANY co-occurrence of "Candy" and "Impact3" and produced 7 hits, most of which correctly said "Former Impact3/Milk Road". Connections outlast a job - what was corrected is present-tense employer access, not the relationship. The two docs that did assert a current route (ZAOOS 224 and 231) are fixed, so this is scope=all.

column1: zaostock-budget
column6: ZAAL, 2026-09-08, ANSWERED DIRECTLY: "$5K PUBLIC, $25K INTERNAL ONLY." ~$5K is the only ZAOstock number that goes outward - any public copy, post, deck or page. $25K stays in planning docs and never appears in public copy. THIS IS A SURFACE RULE, NOT A TRUTH RULE, which is why it is scope=public and not all or new: the figure is CORRECT and still barred from a page. A row can be true and out of bounds. The question this replaced was "is $25K live?" - both answers I offered would have recorded something he did not say, so the menu was escaped rather than answered. Enforced only on paths a repo declares in .claims-public; a repo that declares none is REPORTED as unchecked, never silently passed.
